stem_book: α₁, α₂, α₃, ……, α_(n−1) are the nᵗʰ roots of unity other than 1. Then the product Π_(r=1)^(n−1) (i − α_r) (where i = √−1) can take the value equal to (a) 0 (b) 1 (c) i (d) (1 + i)
